summary: Moved all rounding into meterbill/money.py (exact-integer round_amount/allocate, legacy_cents, fixed), removed the decimal-context line from __init__.py, and added keyword-only method parameters so batch (worker threads) keeps its half-even band charges and effective prices while bill/quote/tariffs keep half-up; tests/test_money.py added, existing tests pass, and a differential fuzz against the original CLI showed no output differences. Kept as-is: inconsistencies such as half-even in batch vs half-up elsewhere, whole-unit payables dropping the sign of zero; only difference is that 28+ digit kWh quantities, which crashed the original with InvalidOperation, now compute.
